analyst_view.overall: Getafe (15th, 12 pts) host Atlético Madrid (3rd, 28 pts) on Sunday night; Bordalás's Getafe are unbeaten at home this season (three wins, three draws), while Atlético come off defeats to Bayern and Barcelona but have won four straight away games, and Simeone has won eight of his last ten visits to Getafe. Gudelj is banned and Uche and Juanmi are out (in the numbers); Zaid Romero is a doubt and Mayoral is over a stomach bug. Atlético are without Lookman and Pubill (in the numbers), and Cuti Romero is also ruled out, which the numbers don't list but which is already in their recent results after five missed games; Julián Álvarez, Sørloth, Giuliano Simeone and Hjulmand were still finishing recovery work after international duty. Atlético host Viking in the Champions League on Wednesday. No referee had been named in the pages I read.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.2 goals and take Lookman and Pubill off. What they can't see: several Atlético internationals were still doing recovery work on Thursday, and Getafe's home games under Bordalás are slow and tight, with previews expecting a set-piece game. A small lean down to about 2.1.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.3 corners and already count Getafe's high recent corner count (38 in six games). Getafe play direct and win corners from long balls and crosses at home, while Atlético have less pace out wide without Lookman, which the numbers count. Nothing points clearly either way, so 9.3.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.3 cards, counting both teams' card form and past meetings, but the game is not flagged as a derby. It is a Madrid-area meeting against a Bordalás side built on fouls, duels and slowing the game, and these meetings tend to get heated. With no referee named yet, a mild lean up to about 5.5.

shots.text: The numbers say 24.6 shots, and recent form has already pushed both sides up (+13% Getafe, +8% Atlético). Getafe rely on long balls and rarely build many shots, and Atlético's tired internationals point to a managed game; the Champions League game is Wednesday against Viking, so heavy rotation is less likely than I first thought. A small trim to about 23.9.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7.4 shots on target. A slow, stop-start game with Atlético's forwards just back from international duty should mean few clear chances, while Lookman's absence is already counted. A slight lean down to about 7.2.
